items.caution: Gurpreet Singh is wanted for his alleged involvement in a transnational criminal organization engaged in racketeer influenced and corrupt organizations conspiracy; conspiracy to engage in the business of dealing in firearms without a license; conspiracy to distribute and possess with intent to distribute controlled substances; and distribution of controlled substances. This organization, The Jaggu Bhagwanpuria Organized Crime Group, originated in the Punjab state of India and operated in the Central District of California and elsewhere.  On June 25, 2026, a federal arrest warrant was issued for Singh in the United States District Court, Central District of California, Los Angeles, California, after he was charged with Conspiracy to Distribute and Possess with Intent to Distribute Controlled Substances and Distribution of Controlled Substances.

items.reward_text: The FBI is offering a reward of up to $5,000 for information leading to the arrest and conviction of the individuals involved in these shootings.
items.title: TRIPLE HOMICIDE - DELAWARE
items.details:
The FBI's Baltimore Field Office is seeking information regarding the shooting of four people, three of whom died, in Wilmington, Delaware.  On March 24, 2026, at approximately 2:23 p.m., officers from the Wilmington Police Department responded to the 600 block of N. Adams Street for reports of shots fired.  Upon arrival, the officers located four gunshot victims and rushed them to area hospitals. Two of the victims were pronounced dead upon arrival at the hospital.  On May 4, 2026, a third individual succumbed to her injuries sustained during the shooting.

 

Surveillance video showed the suspect’s vehicle, a Gray Honda CRV bearing Florida license plate QVHX48, drive onto the street. The door of the vehicle slid open and the occupants inside began firing rounds towards the victims. The vehicle was last observed fleeing north onto Adams Street. The vehicle was reported stolen in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on March 4, 2026, and was later recovered after the shooting in Chester, Pennsylvania, on March 26, 2026.
